changes.summary: POST /access_tokens can only target businesses (or their child businesses) that have claimed the app.
changes.quote:
apps can now only target businesses (or child businesses of those businesses) that have claimed them:

POST /<APP_SCOPED_SYSTEM_USER_ID>/access_tokens

changes.summary: POST /business_users can only target businesses (or their child businesses) that have claimed the app.
changes.quote:
apps can now only target businesses (or child businesses of those businesses) that have claimed them:

POST /<APP_SCOPED_SYSTEM_USER_ID>/access_tokens

POST /{business-id}/business_users

changes.summary: POST /system_users can only target businesses (or their child businesses) that have claimed the app.
changes.quote:
apps can now only target businesses (or child businesses of those businesses) that have claimed them:

POST /<APP_SCOPED_SYSTEM_USER_ID>/access_tokens

POST /{business-id}/business_users

POST /{business-id}/system_users

changes.name: engagement
changes.summary: URL engagement counts may no longer match raw counts.
changes.quote: Due to privacy concerns, counts returned by a GET /?id={url}/engagement request may not match raw counts.

changes.name: date_preset
changes.summary: date_preset=lifetime is disabled and replaced by date_preset=maximum, limited to 37 months of data.
changes.quote: The lifetime parameter (date_preset=lifetime) is disabled and replaced with date_preset=maximum

changes.name: agency_client_declaration
changes.summary: agency_client_declaration on AdAccount requires Admin privileges for all operations.
changes.quote: The agency_client_declaration field on the AdAccount node now requires Admin privileges for all operations.

changes.name: email
changes.summary: Business apps created before February 16, 2021 that do not use email are downgraded to Standard access for it.
changes.quote: Apps that are not using the email or public_profile permissions will be downgraded to Standard access for these two permissions.

changes.name: public_profile
changes.summary: Business apps created before February 16, 2021 that do not use public_profile are downgraded to Standard access for it.
changes.quote: Apps that are not using the email or public_profile permissions will be downgraded to Standard access for these two permissions.

changes.name: Standard level
changes.summary: Groups API access moves from Dev/Live mode to Standard and Privileged levels; Standard only returns data for users with a role on the app.
changes.quote: Standard level access will only allow you to get data for users that have a role on your app

changes.name: estimated_payment_details
changes.summary: estimated_payment_details always uses the estimated tax, even for fulfilled orders.
changes.quote: {commerce-order-id}/?fields=estimated_payment_details endpoint. Previously, if an order was not fulfilled, an estimated tax was used, and for fulfilled orders, the fulfilled tax was used. Starting with version 11.0, this endpoint will always use the estimated tax.

changes.name: id
changes.summary: Comment id is not returned for apps using only Page Public Content Access; the user needs the MODERATE task.
changes.quote: The id field for comments will not be returned for any apps that only use the Page Public Content Access feature to query Pages endpoints.

changes.name: inventory
changes.summary: The product inventory field is deprecated in favour of quantity_to_sell_on_facebook.
changes.quote: The inventory field will be deprecated and replaced with a new quantity_to_sell_on_facebook field.

changes.name: like_count
changes.summary: like_count is omitted when IG Media is queried indirectly and the owner hid like counts.
changes.quote: the like_count field will be omitted from API responses if the media owner has hidden like counts on it.

changes.name: reported_object_id
changes.summary: reported_object_id on GET /company/reported_content is deprecated and returns no data.
changes.quote: The reported_object_id field for the GET /company/reported_content endpoint is deprecated. Calls to this field will return no data. Use the new GET /reported_content/reporters endpoint instead.

changes.name: review_status
changes.summary: review_status on Product Item is no longer accepted; use channels_to_integrity_status.
changes.quote: Starting with version 12.0, review_status will not be accepted as a valid field. We recommend that you use the channels_to_integrity_status

changes.name: targeting_as_signal
changes.summary: targeting_as_signal is ignored during ad set creation.
changes.quote: The targeting_as_signal field will be ignored when passed during ad set creation.

changes.name: targeting_optimization
changes.summary: POST /{adset-id} errors when updating targeting_optimization on newly created Value, Conversions or App Events ad sets.
changes.quote: The POST /{adset-id} endpoint will return an error for updates to newly created ad sets with Value, Conversions or App Events as the optimization goals within Conversions objective campaigns using the targeting_optimization field.

changes.name: role
changes.summary: A system user can hold an app role only when it and the app belong to the same business; other roles are revoked.
changes.quote: A system user can now only be granted a role on app if both the system user and the app belong to the same business.

changes.summary: New ad sets optimizing for value, conversions or app events get lookalike expansion on by default, and it cannot be disabled.
changes.quote:
For newly created ad sets that optimize for value, conversions, or app events, lookalike expansion will be turned on by default and cannot be disabled. When getting an ad set that optimizes for value, conversions, or app events, we will return a new lookalike property in the targeting_optimization_types map that indicates lookalike expansion is enabled and complements the existing detailed_targeting property for the detailed targeting expansion.

This change affects the following endpoints:

POST /{ad-account-id}/adsets

changes.summary: Conversions API events with only certain weak customer information parameter combinations are invalid and error.
changes.quote:
There are new requirements for the combinations of customer information parameters that are considered valid for an event. An event will be considered invalid if it only includes parameters consisting of one of the following combinations or a subset thereof:

ct + country + st + zp + ge + client_user_agent

db + client_user_agent

fn + ge

ln + ge

To ensure your events do not throw an error, we recommend that you review the Conversions API Best Practices.

This change affects the following endpoints:

POST /{pixel-id}/events

changes.summary: Ad set creation turns on Advantage custom audience, Advantage lookalike and Advantage detailed targeting by default for the stated objectives (GET and POST /{ad-account-id}/adsets).
changes.quote:
When creating an ad set with any objective and with a non-data file custom audience in inclusion, Advantage custom audiences will be turned on by default.

When creating an ad set with a non-Advantage lookalike objective (that is, Value Optimization, Offsite Conversion, App Installs and Messages) with lookalike in inclusion, Advantage lookalike will be turned on by default.

Advantage custom audience and Advantage lookalike can be enabled or disabled through the targeting_relaxation_types targeting spec parameter. targeting_relaxation_types accepts either custom_audience and lookalike as a key, and if a value of 0 is passed, it will be disabled. If a value of 1 is passed, it will be enabled. If no key/value pair is passed, it will be considered as enabled.

The following endpoints and fields are affected:

GET /{ad-account-id}/adsets

POST /{ad-account-id}/adsets

changes.summary: Incremental conversion optimization campaigns can no longer be created (POST /{ad_account_id}/campaigns).
changes.quote:
advertisers will no longer be allowed to create incremental conversion optimization campaigns. Existing conversion optimization campaigns will behave normally.

The following endpoint is affected:

POST /{ad_account_id}/campaigns

changes.summary: New custom conversions must contain at least one rule (POST /{ad_account_id}/customconversions).
changes.quote:
We now require new Custom Conversions to contain at least one rule when they are created. Otherwise, campaigns should optimize on the event directly.

The following endpoint is affected:

POST /{ad_account_id}/customconversions

changes.summary: Custom Page Tabs are no longer available: POST and DELETE /{page-id}/tabs.
changes.quote:
Custom Page Tabs are no longer available. The following endpoints are affected:

POST /{page-id}/tabs

changes.quote: Templates [created or edited](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview) using v16.0 must now be categorized using one of the following categories; all other categories are no longer supported. Applies to Cloud API v16.0+. Will apply to all versions May 1, 2023.

changes.summary: From v16.0, category validation is part of template review for newly created templates.
changes.quote: Category validation is now part of the template review process for [newly created templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview#create-message-templates). Applies to version v16.0+.

changes.name: TLS
changes.summary: Requests over TLS older than 1.2 or with static RSA cipher suites are no longer accepted.
changes.quote: TLS versions older than 1.2 and static RSA cipher suites are no longer supported.

changes.name: errors
changes.summary: From v16.0, webhook errors objects include message and error_data.details, and titles changed for multiple error codes.
changes.quote: The `errors` object in webhooks triggered by v16.0+ request errors now include `message` and `error_data.details` properties, and `title` values have changed for multiple error codes.

changes.summary: GET /{user-id}/accounts (and /me/accounts) no longer returns Pages linked to a business account unless the user granted business_management and has a role on that business.
changes.quote: The GET /{user-id}/accounts (aka GET /me/accounts) endpoint no longer returns Facebook pages that have been linked to a Meta business account, unless the app user has granted the business_management permission to the app and has a role on the linked business account.

changes.summary: The Offline Conversions API no longer supports offline events: POST /{offline_event_set_id}/events.
changes.quote: Starting with Graph API v17.0, the Offline Conversions API will no longer support offline events.

changes.summary: All Instant Articles API endpoints are not available on v17.0 or later.
changes.quote: All Instant Articles API endpoints are not available on v17 or later and will be removed for all versions on August 21, 2023.

changes.summary: The ThreatExchange /malware_analyses endpoint is not available on v17.0 or later.
changes.quote: The /malware_analyses endpoint is deprecated. It is not available on v17 or later and will be removed for all versions on August 21, 2023.

changes.summary: From v17, sending a paused template returns error 132015 instead of 132001.
changes.quote: Attempting to send a paused template in a template message using v17 or later now returns [error code `132015`](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/error-codes#other-errors) instead of `132001`.

changes.summary: From v17, sending a disabled template returns error 132016 instead of 132001.
changes.quote: Attempting to send a disabled template in a template message using v17 or later now returns [error code `132016`](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/error-codes#other-errors) instead of `132001`.

changes.name: business_management

changes.quote: The GET /{user-id}/accounts (aka GET /me/accounts) endpoint no longer returns Facebook pages that have been linked to a Meta business account, unless the app user has granted the business_management permission to the app and has a role on the linked business account.

changes.name: package_name
changes.summary: From v21.0, package_name must be defined within the supported_apps array when creating one-tap autofill and zero-tap authentication templates.
changes.quote:
Starting with version 21.0 the `package_name` and `signature_hash` parameters must be defined within the `supported_apps` array when creating [one-tap autofill](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/authentication-templates/autofill-button-authentication-templates#post-body) and [zero-tap](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/authentication-templates/zero-tap-authentication-templates#post-body) authentication templates.
* Starting with version 21.0, to enable [local storage](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/local-storage) on a business phone number, the number must be in an unregistered state, and you must use the [**POST /<WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER>/settings**](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-phone-number/settings-api#Updating) endpoint to enable local storage before registering the number (instead of enabling during registration). To support these changes:
* Added a `storage_configuration` parameter to the [**POST /<WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER>/settings**](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-phone-number/settings-api#Updating) endpoint, which can be used to enable or disable local storage.
* Removed the `data_localization_region` parameter from the [**POST /<WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER>/register**](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-phone-number/register-api#Creating) endpoint.

changes.summary: Detailed targeting exclusions and Special Ad Category customer list rules change adsets requests.
changes.quote:
When creating or updating an ad set, an error message will be shown when adding any new detailed targeting exclusions that are not within audience control exclusions at the account level.

When duplicating an ad set, detailed targeting exclusions (except audience control exclusions at the account level) will be removed in the new campaign.

When trying to get a delivery estimate, only employer exclusions will be allowed for detailed targeting.

As a result of this change, custom audiences will be deprecated within the exclusions field. You can still continue using custom audience exclusions by using the excluded_custom_audiences field instead. For more details see Advanced Targeting: Custom Audiences.

The following endpoints are affected:

POST /{ad-account-id}/adsets

changes.summary: Requests to adcreatives change on v26.0 (placements, HEC-F audiences, Web+App destinations, poll ads and Shop ads defaults).
changes.quote:
Poll components are no longer supported when creating or updating ads and creatives. The poll_spec field and poll type under interactive_components_spec are unavailable. Updates that do not change the creative can continue. Remove poll-related fields from creative specifications.

Affected endpoints:

POST /{ad-account-id}/adcreatives

changes.summary: Requests to ads change on v26.0 (placements, HEC-F audiences, Web+App destinations, poll ads and Shop ads defaults).
changes.quote:
A creative with applink_treatment=web_only can no longer be attached to an ad in a campaign using Website and App conversion locations. Use automatic destination selection or a compatible manual destination.

Affected endpoints:

POST /act_{ad-account-id}/ads

changes.summary: Requests to adsets change on v26.0 (placements, HEC-F audiences, Web+App destinations, poll ads and Shop ads defaults).
changes.quote:
The Instagram Explore Feed placement is no longer available. Delivery shifts to other eligible placements, and requests that explicitly specify Explore return an error. Remove Explore from placement configurations.

Affected endpoints:

POST /act_{ad-account-id}/adsets

changes.summary: Requests to generatepreviews change on v26.0 (placements, HEC-F audiences, Web+App destinations, poll ads and Shop ads defaults).
changes.quote:
Poll components are no longer supported when creating or updating ads and creatives. The poll_spec field and poll type under interactive_components_spec are unavailable. Updates that do not change the creative can continue. Remove poll-related fields from creative specifications.

Affected endpoints:

POST /{ad-account-id}/adcreatives

POST /{ad-account-id}/ads

POST /{ad-id}

GET /{ad-account-id}/generatepreviews

changes.name: pages_messaging
changes.summary: Messenger apps without business verification by July 19, 2022 lose the pages_messaging permission and cannot send or receive messages.
changes.quote: If apps don't complete business verification by then, they won't be able to send and receive messages via Messenger and pages_messaging permission for these apps will be revoked.

changes.name: operation_status
changes.summary: Special Ad Audiences are deprecated; operation_status on customaudiences is affected.
changes.quote:
You can no longer create Special Ad Audiences. Special Ad Audiences endpoints will be removed no later than December 31, 2022.

The following endpoints and fields are affected:

GET /{ad-account-id}/customaudiences?fields=operation_status

changes.name: subtype
changes.summary: Special Ad Audiences can no longer be created; the subtype field is affected.
changes.quote:
You can no longer create Special Ad Audiences. Special Ad Audiences endpoints will be removed no later than December 31, 2022.

The following endpoints and fields are affected:

GET /{ad-account-id}/customaudiences?fields=operation_status

POST /{ad-account-id}/adsets?fields=subtype

changes.name: Story insights
changes.summary: Story insights webhook notifications are sent 1 hour after story expiration.
changes.quote: Story insights webhooks notifications are now sent 1 hour after story expiration.

changes.name: notification_messages_frequency
changes.summary: notification_messages_frequency on recurring notification opt-ins is deprecated and no longer returned in GET responses.
changes.quote: The `notification_messages_frequency` property for [recurring notification opt in requests](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/send-messages/recurring-notifications) is **deprecated** and will no longer be returned in `GET` requests or webhook notifications.

changes.name: sample values
changes.summary: Templates that use variables now require sample values on creation or editing, in all versions.
changes.quote: Templates that rely on variables now require sample values upon [creation or editing](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview). Applies to all versions.

changes.name: page_impressions_organic
changes.summary: page_impressions_organic is renamed.
changes.quote: page_impressions_organic renamed to page_impressions_organic_v2

changes.name: page_impressions_organic_unique
changes.summary: page_impressions_organic_unique is renamed.
changes.quote: page_impressions_organic_unique renamed to page_impressions_organic_unique_v2

changes.summary: On-Premises API now returns error 2061 when sending a paused template.
changes.quote: Attempting to send a paused template in a template message now returns [error code `2061`](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/on-premises/errors).

changes.summary: On-Premises API now returns error 2062 when sending a disabled template.
changes.quote: Attempting to send a disabled template in a template message now returns [error code `2062`](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/on-premises/errors).

changes.name: instagram_positions
changes.summary: The shop value of instagram_positions is no longer available for new campaigns.
changes.quote: The Instagram Shop tab ad placement (“instagram_positions”: [“shop”]) is no longer available for new ad campaigns.

changes.summary: Business Management API can return error 2494100 when a business phone number is temporarily in maintenance mode.
changes.quote: Added Business Management API [error code `2494100`](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/error-codes) that indicates a business phone number is temporarily in maintenance mode.

changes.name: whatsapp_business_messaging
changes.summary: Solution Partners must request the whatsapp_business_messaging permission to use Cloud API calls.
changes.quote: We are [requiring Solution Partners to request the whatsapp_business_messaging permission](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/embedded-signup/overview#meta-app) to use the API calls on the Cloud API, hosted by Meta.

changes.summary: GET requests on the WABA phone_numbers edge now return error 200 when the token user lacks WhatsApp Business Account Access.
changes.quote: GET requests on [WhatsApp Business Account > Phone Numbers](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-account/phone-number-management-api) and [WhatsApp Business Account > Message Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-account/template-api) now return error code `200` if the user identified by token has not been granted appropriate [WhatsApp Business Account Access]

changes.name: code_expiration_minutes
changes.summary: Authentication templates with the code expiration warning now use code_expiration_minutes to choose between autofill and copy code buttons, and autofill buttons disable after that time.
changes.quote:
using the code expiration warning now use the `code_expiration_minutes` value (instead of a default of 10 minutes) to determine if the delivered template message should display an autofill button or copy code button.
* Autofill buttons displayed in a delivered template message will become disabled after the amount of time indicated by the template's `code_expiration_minutes` value, if present (or after 10 minutes, if not present).

changes.name: button
changes.summary: Carousel template creation now requires at least one button.
changes.quote: [Carousel template](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/message-templates/carousel-templates) creation now requires at least one button.

changes.name: media_type
changes.summary: The VIDEO value of media_type is no longer supported for container creation; use REELS.
changes.quote: Beginning November 9, 2023, the `VIDEO` value for `media_type` will no longer be supported. Use the `REELS` media type to publish a video to your feed.

changes.name: bid_amount
changes.summary: bid_amount is no longer accepted on ads and updating it errors; set it on the ad set.
changes.quote: Starting March 11th, 2024, we will no longer support providing a bid_amount value on ads. Instead please use the bid_amount value in the ad set as the source of truth. API calls attempting to update the bid_amount for an ad will result in an error.

changes.name: takeover config
changes.summary: The default-app takeover config for Messenger Conversation Routing is deprecated in favor of app-level configs, with values migrated.
changes.quote: The original takeover config that's coupled with the default app is now deprecated with all values migrated.

changes.name: Cache-Control
changes.summary: Media asset caching is no longer developer-definable via the Cache-Control header; it is fixed at 10 minutes.
changes.quote: Changed media asset caching behavior from developer definable (via Cache-Control header) to a fixed time period of 10 minutes.

changes.name: Instagram Basic Display API
changes.summary: The Instagram Basic Display API is shut down; all requests return an error.
changes.quote:
The Instagram Basic Display API has been deprecated. All requests to the Instagram Basic Display API will return an error message. We recommend that you migrate your app to the
[**Instagram API**]

changes.name: business_basic
changes.summary: The business_basic scope value is deprecated on January 27, 2025, replaced by instagram_business_basic.
changes.quote:
* `instagram_business_basic`
* `instagram_business_content_publish`
* `instagram_business_manage_comments`
* `instagram_business_manage_messages`

These will replace the existing `business_basic`, `business_content_publish`, `business_manage_comments` and `business_manage_messages` values, respectively.

changes.name: business_content_publish
changes.summary: The business_content_publish scope value is deprecated on January 27, 2025, replaced by instagram_business_content_publish.
changes.quote:
* `instagram_business_basic`
* `instagram_business_content_publish`
* `instagram_business_manage_comments`
* `instagram_business_manage_messages`

These will replace the existing `business_basic`, `business_content_publish`, `business_manage_comments` and `business_manage_messages` values, respectively.

changes.name: business_manage_comments
changes.summary: The business_manage_comments scope value is deprecated on January 27, 2025, replaced by instagram_business_manage_comments.
changes.quote:
* `instagram_business_basic`
* `instagram_business_content_publish`
* `instagram_business_manage_comments`
* `instagram_business_manage_messages`

These will replace the existing `business_basic`, `business_content_publish`, `business_manage_comments` and `business_manage_messages` values, respectively.

changes.name: business_manage_messages
changes.summary: The business_manage_messages scope value is deprecated on January 27, 2025, replaced by instagram_business_manage_messages.
changes.quote:
* `instagram_business_basic`
* `instagram_business_content_publish`
* `instagram_business_manage_comments`
* `instagram_business_manage_messages`

These will replace the existing `business_basic`, `business_content_publish`, `business_manage_comments` and `business_manage_messages` values, respectively.

changes.name: Payments API
changes.summary: The Payments API is no longer available for business portfolios with Singapore addresses (Cloud and On-Premises API).
changes.quote: Payments API for business portfolios with Singapore addresses is no longer available.

changes.name: allow_category_change
changes.summary: Template creation no longer supports allow_category_change; recategorizing to marketing is now the default behaviour.
changes.quote: We no longer support the `allow_category_change` property during template creation. Previously, if set to true in a template creation request, this allowed us to update a template's category to marketing, if we determined marketing to be its category per its content and our guidelines. This is now the default behavior.

changes.name: enable_fb_login
changes.summary: The enable_fb_login parameter of Business Login for Instagram was deprecated.
changes.quote:
The following parameters have been deprecated for Business Login for Instagram:

* `enable_fb_login`
* `force_authentication`

changes.name: force_authentication
changes.summary: The force_authentication parameter of Business Login for Instagram was deprecated.
changes.quote:
The following parameters have been deprecated for Business Login for Instagram:

* `enable_fb_login`
* `force_authentication`

changes.name: On-Behalf-Of
changes.summary: The On-Behalf-Of account ownership model is deprecated; from September 30, 2025 WABAs can no longer be onboarded to it, replaced by partner-initiated WABA creation.
changes.quote: Added [partner-initiated WABA creation](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/overview) to replace the [On-Behalf-Of](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/obo-model-deprecation) ("OBO") account ownership model, which is [being deprecated](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/obo-model-deprecation). Starting September 30, 2025, WABAs can no longer be onboarded to the OBO model.

changes.name: messages
changes.summary: Incoming text messages webhooks no longer carry ad click IDs for messages originating from WhatsApp Status ad placements.
changes.quote: Ad click IDs will not be included in incoming [text messages](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/webhooks/reference/messages/text) webhooks payloads describing an incoming message that originated from a [WhatsApp Status ad placements]

changes.name: Handover Protocol
changes.summary: Handover Protocol is no longer supported for Instagram; businesses were migrated to Conversation Routing.
changes.quote: Meta no longer supports the Handover Protocol for Instagram. All businesses have been migrated to [Conversation Routing]

changes.name: author_name
changes.summary: author_name is removed from the Instagram post oEmbed response on November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: The `author_name`, `author_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `thumbnail_width`, and `thumbnail_height` fields will be removed from the Facebook post, Facebook video, and Instagram post oEmbed response.

changes.name: author_url
changes.summary: author_url is removed from the Instagram post oEmbed response on November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: The `author_name`, `author_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `thumbnail_width`, and `thumbnail_height` fields will be removed from the Facebook post, Facebook video, and Instagram post oEmbed response.

changes.name: thumbnail_height
changes.summary: thumbnail_height is removed from the Instagram post oEmbed response on November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: The `author_name`, `author_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `thumbnail_width`, and `thumbnail_height` fields will be removed from the Facebook post, Facebook video, and Instagram post oEmbed response.

changes.name: thumbnail_url
changes.summary: thumbnail_url is removed from the Instagram post oEmbed response on November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: The `author_name`, `author_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `thumbnail_width`, and `thumbnail_height` fields will be removed from the Facebook post, Facebook video, and Instagram post oEmbed response.

changes.name: thumbnail_width
changes.summary: thumbnail_width is removed from the Instagram post oEmbed response on November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: The `author_name`, `author_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `thumbnail_width`, and `thumbnail_height` fields will be removed from the Facebook post, Facebook video, and Instagram post oEmbed response.

changes.name: oEmbed Read
changes.summary: The oEmbed Read feature is deprecated on November 3, 2025 and replaced by Meta oEmbed Read.
changes.quote: Introducing the new [**Meta oEmbed Read**](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/features-reference/meta-oembed-read) feature that is replacing the existing oEmbed Read feature.

changes.name: Facebook page post oEmbed endpoint
changes.summary: The Facebook page post oEmbed endpoint is deprecated.
changes.quote: The Facebook page post oEmbed endpoint will be deprecated.

changes.name: share
changes.summary: The share attachment for Instagram post shares was scheduled for removal after February 1, 2026 in favor of ig_post.
changes.quote: The old `share` attachment type will continue to be supported for Instagram posts until **February 1, 2026**, after which it will be removed. Partners and integrators are encouraged to migrate to the new `ig_post` attachment type

changes.name: view_count
changes.summary: Business Discovery view_count now combines Instagram and Facebook views for crossposted video.
changes.quote: * **Cross-platform `view_count`:** The `view_count` field now returns combined Instagram and Facebook views for crossposted video content when looking up another user's public media via the Business Discovery API.

changes.name: facebook_views
changes.summary: facebook_views now covers Feed, Reels and Story media and includes cross-app recommended plays.
changes.quote: * **`facebook_views` expansion:** The [`facebook_views`](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media/insights) metric now supports Feed post, Reels, and Story media types, and coverage has expanded to include both crossposted plays and cross-app recommended plays.

changes.summary: Requests with the deprecated message tags CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE, ACCOUNT_UPDATE and POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE return error code 100.
changes.quote: Effective April 27, 2026 all API requests containing the deprecated Message Tags CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE, ACCOUNT_UPDATE, and POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE will receive error code 100

changes.name: ACCOUNT_UPDATE
changes.summary: Send API requests using the deprecated message tag ACCOUNT_UPDATE are rejected with error code 100 from April 27, 2026.
changes.quote: Effective April 27, 2026 all API requests containing the deprecated Message Tags CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE, ACCOUNT_UPDATE, and POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE will receive error code 100

changes.name: CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE
changes.summary: Send API requests using the deprecated message tag CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE are rejected with error code 100 from April 27, 2026.
changes.quote: Effective April 27, 2026 all API requests containing the deprecated Message Tags CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE, ACCOUNT_UPDATE, and POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE will receive error code 100

changes.name: POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE
changes.summary: Send API requests using the deprecated message tag POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE are rejected with error code 100 from April 27, 2026.
changes.quote: Effective April 27, 2026 all API requests containing the deprecated Message Tags CONFIRMED_EVENT_UPDATE, ACCOUNT_UPDATE, and POST_PURCHASE_UPDATE will receive error code 100

changes.name: share
changes.summary: The legacy share attachment is removed from Instagram post share webhook payloads, leaving only ig_post as rollout reaches each app.
changes.quote: The legacy `share` attachment type is being removed from Instagram post share webhook payloads. As announced on [October 30, 2025](#october-30-2025), the `share` attachment has been deprecated in favor of the `ig_post` attachment type

changes.name: media_url
changes.summary: IG Media media_url is now omitted for videos with copyrighted or licensed audio and for reels whose owner disabled downloads.
changes.quote: The `media_url` field on the [IG Media](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/instagram-platform/reference/instagram-media) endpoint is now omitted from responses in either of these cases:

changes.name: Graph API v20.0
changes.summary: Graph API v20.0 is deprecated and removed.
changes.quote: Graph API v20.0 is deprecated and removed.

changes.name: Graph API v21.0
changes.summary: Graph API v21.0 is deprecated and removed.
changes.quote: Graph API v21.0 is deprecated and removed.

changes.name: On-Premises API
changes.summary: The final WhatsApp On-Premises API client (v2.63) expired on October 23, 2025, and the On-Premises API can no longer send messages; Meta points to the Cloud API.
changes.quote: The final supported version of the On-Premise API client expired on October 23, 2025. On-Premises API can't be used to send messages to WhatsApp users anymore. Please use Cloud API on the WhatsApp Business Platform instead.

changes.summary: GET requests on the WABA message_templates edge now return error 200 when the token user lacks access, as phone_numbers does.
changes.quote: GET requests on [WhatsApp Business Account > Phone Numbers](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-account/phone-number-management-api) and [WhatsApp Business Account > Message Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/reference/whatsapp-business-account/template-api) now return error code `200`

changes.name: authentication templates
changes.summary: Legacy authentication templates, without one-time password buttons, can no longer be sent, edited or appealed after April 1, 2024.
changes.quote: Legacy authentication templates (authentication templates without [one-time password buttons](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/authentication-templates/authentication-templates)) can continue to be sent, edited, and appealed until April 1, 2024 (extended from October 2, 2023).

changes.name: time-to-live
changes.summary: Cloud API template message delivery is retried for up to 30 days instead of 24 hours.
changes.quote: Changed Cloud API template message delivery retry time-to-live from 24 hours to 30 days.

changes.name: registration/deregistration
changes.summary: Phone number registration and deregistration are limited to 10 requests per number in a 72-hour moving window.
changes.quote: Changed business phone number [registration/deregistration](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration) attempt limits to 10 requests per business number in a 72 hour moving window (was a one-week moving window).

changes.name: media ID
changes.summary: A media ID received through a webhook can be downloaded for 7 days after October 9, 2025, down from 30 days.
changes.quote: when retrieving a media from a media ID received via webhook, the media ID will only be available to download for 30 days. After October 9th this will only be available for 7 days.

changes.name: webhooks
changes.summary: Cloud API retries failed webhook notifications for up to 7 days instead of 30.
changes.quote: Cloud API will now reattempt to deliver failed webhooks notifications for up to 7 days instead of up to 30 days.

changes.name: Handover Protocol
changes.summary: Every Page moves to the new Handover Protocol behaviour (no primary or secondary receiver roles), with breaking changes for existing integrations, by March 18, 2022.
changes.quote: As per the announcement on September 14, 2021, all Facebook pages will now be migrated to support the new Handover Protocol behavior. We expect to have all Pages migrated by March 18, 2022.

changes.name: persistent menu
changes.summary: Setting commands on the Messenger Profile replaces an existing persistent menu.
changes.quote: If you already have a persistent menu set for your Messenger experience, the commands menu will override it.

changes.name: notification message tokens
changes.summary: Notification message tokens are no longer tied to an app ID; every app linked to the Page receives opt-in webhooks.
changes.quote: App IDs will no longer be associated with notification message tokens. All apps linked to a Page will now receive opt in webhook notifications

changes.name: ig_post
changes.summary: Instagram post-share webhooks carry two attachments, share and a new ig_post, from November 3, 2025.
changes.quote: Starting November 3, 2025, the webhook payload for Instagram post shares will include two attachments: the existing `share` attachment and a new `ig_post` attachment.
